about: The items ladder's authored half (docs/design/items.md): each Black Marsh item of gear and the material of ours it is made of (item_material), and each ware (ingredient, food and drink, poison, tool, trade good) with the good whose makers make it and, where it grows or drops in the wild, the ecology's harvestable it comes from (item_good; newworld/sources/ecology/harvestables.json stays the home of what grows where). `stockdb items` measures every item named here into items.json; an item with no row reads its material from its Skyrim keyword (materials.json `keywords`). A row's `tier` is set only where a record's numbers are a mod's own error, with its reason; otherwise the tier is measured by power (split.item_tier).
